output.reason: The release note [ev-8b7179788e16] and the linked PR [ev-ac46594040d5] say the deprecated `spec.controllerConfigRef` field was removed from the package types. The PR adds that the code using the field had already been removed and only the field itself was left to clean up. The PR's changed files [ev-40656fb4dfee] name the affected subject: the pkg.crossplane.io CRDs for providers, providerrevisions, functions and functionrevisions, plus the v1 and v1beta1 package runtime types. That is enough to type the subject and the removal, with applicability being those kinds when they set the field. The consequence can be written as a schema-only removal of a field that already did nothing, but no source states what happens to manifests that still set it, so confidence is low.
